messages.subject: R763 literature report complete
messages.body: Read AGENTS.md, the retention policy, the research index, and R751–760 with Main’s corrections, then wrote a 1,395-word bounded report on database fusion/output allocation, device-driven sparse worklists, stencil recomputation, and graph reuse. It records source-qualified tradeoffs and calculates a 75.3 ms bandwidth-only floor for the route-map payload at the assumed 6 GB/s while preserving the mapped-USM and CPU-critical-path caveats. No implementation or performance result was produced; Main should review the report, make any corrections, and add it to the research index.

messages.subject: R761 stable grouping research complete
messages.body: Wrote the bounded report with a five-pass stable group/scan/scatter design, exact ordering rule, scratch/work/byte budget, and a safe comparison plan tied to current SYCL code and public specifications. It shows how device-local slot/src maps could reduce host-visible route data while still returning counts and offsets for current oneMKL per-expert calls; the existing wait is not eliminated, and measured grouping time excludes route wait and map completion. No implementation or performance test was done; Main can decide whether boundary attribution justifies a default-off single-GPU component trial, followed by correctness and 262144-context gates.
